path.description: The location of the Snapcraft project.  Defaults to the base of the repository

build-info.description:
Whether to include build information in the resulting snap.
This will add snap/manifest.yaml and snap/snapcraft.yaml files to the snap.  The Snap Store can use

snapcraft-channel.description:
The Snapcraft channel to use
By default, the action will use the stable version of Snapcraft to build the project.  This parameter can be used to instead select

snapcraft-args.description:
Additional arguments to pass to Snapcraft
Some experimental Snapcraft features are disabled by default and must be turned on via a `--enable-experimental-*` com

ua-token.description:
UA token to attach in build environment.
Snapcraft will detach the token when no longer required.
